text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts detected in prod-us-west-2 (p95 and p99 spikes) after deploy #deploy-2026-04-11-17. Auto-escalating to #incidents and paging oncall.
eli: on it. pinging @sasha and @tara. any immediate customer-facing issues reported?
sasha: saw surge starting at ~2469998800. p95 jumped from 180ms -> 1200ms, p99 from 480ms -> 4.2s. lots of upstream gateway timeouts (504) and some 502s.
tara: deploy-bot shows new image tag redwood/inference:2026.04.11-17-d2ad on gateway-service and api-proxy.
eli: can we confirm rollback is possible immediately? what's the blast radius?
sasha: quick queries:
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (status)
```
shows 5xx rate at 15rps vs baseline 0.8rps. top paths: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings.
eli: @deploy-bot can you validate if rollback to previous revision is non-disruptive?
deploy-bot: rollback available: previous revision redwood/inference:2026.04.11-15-b6c3. can run `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/gateway-service --to-revision=REV` or trigger via console.
raj: i'm on second shift; taking pager. handoff ETA 5m.
eli: tara, can you grab logs from gateway pods and post samples? need stacktraces or OOMs. also check kvcache eviction rates.
tara: logs (snip):
```
2026-04-11T17:02:15Z gateway ERROR timeout waiting for backend conn
2026-04-11T17:02:16Z gateway WARN upstream 10.2.4.12:504 gateway timeout
2026-04-11T17:02:17Z gateway WARN kvcache: evict hit-rate 0.12, miss-rate 0.88
```
No OOMs. connection resets and long backend queueing.
eli: sounds like new image changed connection pooling defaults or introduced sync op. If rollback is fastest mitigation we should do it.
sasha: I'm starting a quick traffic split to route 30% to previous revision as canary rollback to validate. `kubectl patch svc gateway --type=json ...`
ops-bot: Traffic shift applied: gateway-service: 70% -> new, 30% -> prev. Monitoring.
eli: good. watching metrics.
(3m passes)
sasha: p95 down to 400ms, p99 down to 1.2s on canary path. errors on prev rev ~0.9rps.
eli: can we expedite full rollback? if metrics keep trending we should flip.
raj: oncall takeover complete. initiating full rollback now; notifying support for customer comms.
eli: please run `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/gateway-service` and confirm image.
deploy-bot: Rollout undo initiated by raj. New image target: redwood/inference:2026.04.11-15-b6c3. Progressing pods: 3/3 updated.
sasha: watching: p95 ~190ms, p99 ~420ms, 5xx rate back to 0.6rps. frontend errors trending down.
ops-bot: Healthchecks green. circuit-breaker metrics reset.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied: full rollback completed. Incident severity de-escalated to SEV2 — continuing observation.
eli: summary: recent deploy introduced regression causing connection/backpressure at gateway, likely pooling or blocking sync in request path. Immediate mitigation: traffic split then full rollback.
raj: customer-impact: about 3 enterprise customers reported elevated errors (support ticket ids: CS-3421, CS-3423, CS-3424). CS team notified; outreach in progress.
sasha: opened quick dashboard for postmortem: show deploy artifact, config diff, kvcache metrics, kernel version.
tara: saving logs and capturing pod dumps. will upload to incident folder.
eli: next steps: 1) postmortem doc, include blameless root cause, timeline, and deploy checklist to require live perf smoke for gateway. 2) add automated canary traffic split on deploys >5 pods. 3) explore connection pooling tests and unit for kvcache stress.
raj: coordinating follow-up with release-engineering to block rollout until we have canary gating.
eli: thanks all. closing channel once we've verified customer comms and no further regressions for 1 hour. :phone:
incident-bot: Incident thread closed (mitigated). Follow-up: /incidents/postmortem/2469998888 for owners and timeline.
